title: hush_clip_sources
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.12) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_clipSources, FR-1, FR-7; not routed yet. CEP WNC_HUSH.clipSources (signed bridge). The media files under the selected audio clips.

data.description: No data (the PRD's host function takes no argument).

inPoint.description: the clip's in point in the media, seconds

items.description: {path,start,end,inPoint} of one selected audio clip. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.

clips.description: one entry per selected audio clip

readback.description: clips: the selected audio clips' sources. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.
